name: Penumbra
effectText: You conjure dark energy to wound the soul of an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended with Faith. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing. This damage increases by 2[CD] for each Wound you have.

name: Umbra
effectText: You conjure dark energy to wound the soul of an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended with Faith. On hit: 4[CD] Piercing damage. This damage increases by 3[CD] for each Wound you have.

name: Nox
effectText: You carve open gates to the Eternal Void, attempting to cleave through your foe's soul, targeting an enemy within range. Make a Spell Attack defended with Faith. On hit: 6[CD] Piercing, Knockdown damage. This damage increases by 4[CD] for each Wound you have.

name: Shadow Blade
effectText: You imbue your weapon with shadow. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 2[CD]. This damage increases by 2[CD] for each Wound you have.

name: Umbral Shroud
effectText: You wrap yourself in the clinging darkness of the void. You become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you make an Attack while having less than 1 Wound (the Invisibility ends after the attack is made).

name: Umbral Domain
effectText: You create a domain darkness to shroud you and your allies. When you cast this spell, create a Blast 3 area centered on a space within range, which lasts until the end of your next turn. You and all Allied Characters are invisible while within the Area. Any character that starts their turn in the Area while having at least 1 Wound stays Invisible until the end of their turn, even if they leave the Area.

name: Court Death
effectText: As long as you have this spell prepared, your resistance increases to a minimum of 3 if you have 1 Wound, and to a minimum of 5 if you have 2 Wounds.

name: Profane Death
effectText: As long as you have this spell prepared, you do not become Incapacitated or Fall Prone when reaching 0 HP as long as you have any Willpower (you still suffer an Injury). Any further damage you take will be taken as Willpower damage instead - you become Incapacitated and Fall Prone if you do not have any Willpower remaining.

name: Soul Drain
effectText: You seep the life force of an enemy within Range. Make a Spell Attack defended with Presence. On hit: 1[CD] Piercing 2 damage. You regain HP equal to the amount of HP the target lost from this attack.

name: Soul Siphon
effectText: You siphon life force from an enemy within Range to empower yourself. Make a Spell Attack defended with Presence. On hit: 2[CD] Piercing 2 damage. You regain HP equal to the amount of HP the target lost from this attack, and you gain a bonus d20 on the next Magick or Skirmish task you make until the end of your next turn.

name: Soul Consumption
effectText: You consume the life force from an enemy within Reach to empower yourself. Make a Melee Spell Attack defended with Presence. On hit: 3[CD] Piercing 2 Vicious 1 damage. You regain HP equal to the amount of HP the target lost from this attack, and you gain a bonus d20 on the next Magick or Skirmish task you make until the end of your next turn.

name: Siphoning Strike
effectText: You imbue your weapon with life-sucking energy. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 2[CD], and you regain HP equal to the number of Effects rolled on this attack.

name: Geist Strike
effectText: You imbue your weapon with spectral energy that befuddles the psyche. The damage of your next Attack with a Melee Weapon increases by 1[CD] and on a successful hit the Target treats you as Invisible until the end of your next turn.

name: Blood Bargain
effectText: You exchange vitality for power. When you cast this spell, you immediately lose a fixed amount of HP from the following options: HP equal to 1 Health Bar: You regain 4 Willpower. HP equal to 2 Health Bars: You regain 6 Willpower, and the Difficulty of your next Magick task until the end of your next turn decreases by 1.

name: Blood Heal
effectText: You expend your own life force to heal an ally within Range. First, choose an amount of [CD] and roll. You immediately lose that much HP as an additional cost to this spell. Then, make a Difficulty 2 Magick + Medicine task. On a success, the ally heals for twice the amount of HP you lost.

name: Blood Sickness
effectText: You poison the blood of an enemy with range. Make a Special Spell Attack using Magick + Medicine defended with Faith. On hit: 2 + Medicine [CD] Piercing, Persistent 3 damage.

name: Blood Contagion
effectText: You create a miasma of disease in a Blast 2 Area within range. Make a Special Spell Attack using Magick + Medicine defended with Faith. On hit: 2 + Medicine [CD] Piercing, Persistent 3 damage.

name: Blood Doom
effectText: You create a cloud of cursed blood in a Blast 2 Area within range. Make a Special Spell Attack using Magick + Medicine defended with Faith. On hit: 3 + Medicine [CD] Piercing, Persistent 3 damage.
